exposure: Prenatal exposure to histamine 2 receptor antagonist (H(2)RA)
Prenatal exposure to antacids-proton pump inhibitors (PPIs)
cohort: Term infants born at 'Soroka' University Medical Center (SUMC) between 2001 and 2018
finding: The incidence of PDA in term infants was higher than previously reported and was significantly associated with prenatal exposure to H(2)RA and PPIs.
